body:
**Tier: T4 (money)** — pairs with backend **#654** (subscription-intent). **Merge order (OR-112-13): #654 and #334 merge as a pair; this PR merges only after backend #654 and backend #628 (End my plan) are deployed.**

| | |
|---|---|
| **Tier** | T4 — client money path: subscriptions + one-time PaymentIntents through the native PaymentSheet, PaymentSheet secrets, idempotency |
| **Why** | Owner's most critical item: every surface that sells a package must sell renewing plans as real subscriptions (one-time-only is never acceptable). OR-113-1 native TGP-themed PaymentSheet, no hosted Checkout / webview. OR-113-2 Apple Pay + Google Pay off by config until a merchant ID exists |
| **T4 trigger scan** | Money movement: yes (subscription-intent, payment-intent, PaymentSheet payment + setup mode). CI gate files (`.github/workflows/*`, `scripts/ci/*`, branch protection): **none touched**. package.json / lockfile: **not touched** (`@stripe/stripe-react-native` already a dependency) |
| **T3 trigger scan** | Auth/session: none. Privacy: client_secret / ephemeral key stay inside one call in memory; never in React state, logs, Sentry or analytics (test-locked). New env names (optional, off by default): `EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_MERCHANT_IDENTIFIER`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_PAY_ENABLED`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_MERCHANT_COUNTRY` (config/expected-env.json, .env.example). `app.config.js` adds the Stripe config plugin only when those are set. No migrations |
| **Bounded T1** | Copy; share-link load errors no longer echo server messages |
| **Builder / owner** | Builder: TGP Agent 114 lane B-RECUR-MOB (Claude Opus 5.5); fix round 2 B-RECUR-BE (agent 114); fix round 3 lane B-RECUR-3 (operator agent 115), which owns this PR and #654 until merged. Needs an independent audit |
| **Acceptance evidence** | Fix round 3: failing-before one-job CI lane run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142521981 (18 failed) and this PR's checks at head. Earlier: New/updated suites pass at head (below); failing-before run on 5b6eb654: 24/25 sheet behaviours fail, the other 3 new suites fail. Required checks at head: see PR checks |
| **Promotion triggers** | Already T4. Re-grade stays T4 on any change to the #654 / #628 contract |

## One purchase flow for every sell surface

`src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts`:
- **Renewing** (`billing_type: recurring`, or combo `recurring_amount_cents` + `recurring_interval`) -> `POST /v1/checkout/subscription-intent { package_id, idempotency_key, expected_amount_cents }` -> PaymentSheet in **payment** mode (`pi_` secret) or **setup** mode for a trial (`seti_` secret, "Start free trial") -> "Confirming your plan": bounded polling of `GET /v1/checkout/subscriptions/:id` until entitled (~30 s), then a calm "still confirming" state with Check again / Continue -> success moment ("Your plan is active" / "Your trial has started" with the next / first charge date).
- **One-time** -> `POST /v1/checkout/payment-intent` -> PaymentSheet -> entitlement wait. **$0** -> `POST /v1/packages/:id/claim-free`.

| Surface | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Day 1 sheet / package_prompt (`PackageSelectionSheet`) | refused renewing plans | shared flow |
| Membership plans (`ClientPackagesScreen`) | hosted Checkout in `BrandedCheckoutWebView` | shared flow + **Your plans** panel (next charge, End my plan via #628, Keep my plan via #654 resume) |
| Share link `tgp://p/:token` (`PackageCheckoutScreen` / `PackageDetailSurface`) | hosted Checkout in webview | shared flow (3 optional props on the surface) |
| Join links / paywall | sell through the surfaces above | unchanged |

**Terms before paying** (`PlanTermsBlock`): price + interval, first charge incl. any one-time part, trial length and the date of the first charge, renewal line, cancel anytime in Membership. CTA from the terms ("Subscribe for $99.00 a month", "Subscribe, pay $250.00 today", "Start free trial", "Pay $X").

**Every backend code has its own calm copy and a next action** (`describeBackendFailure`): `PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED` shows the new price and "Continue at $X" (same idempotency key); `SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE` -> Open your plan; `COACH_NOT_CONNECTED`; `COACH_NOT_PAYOUT_READY`; `PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND` (share-link variant); `CLIENT_NOT_FOUND`; `CONTRACT_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED`; `PACKAGE_INTERVAL_INVALID`; `ONE_TIME_REQUIRES_PAYMENT_INTENT` / `RECURRING_REQUIRES_SUBSCRIPTION` (terms changed, list reloads); `PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS` / `PAYMENT_RETRY`; `PURCHASE_NOT_FOUND` / `PLAN_ALREADY_ENDED`; `SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE` / `STRIPE_CHECKOUT_ERROR` / `CONNECT_NOT_CONFIGURED` and anything unknown -> short reference + Email support + Sentry (no PII, no secrets); 429 with minutes; sheet canceled (silent) vs declined vs insufficient funds vs 3DS vs offline. No "Something went wrong", no first person, no exclamation marks.

**Idempotency**: one key per purchase attempt, reused on retry / cancel / decline / network / price confirm, spent after the sheet succeeds; in-flight guard so a double tap makes one attempt.

**Apple Pay / Google Pay (OR-113-2)**: Apple Pay only on iOS with a valid `merchant.*` ID; Google Pay only on Android with the switch on (test env for `pk_test_`). Unset = no wallet, no error, no dead button.

## Tests
`npx jest --runInBand` (targeted): `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription` 26/26 (new), `ClientPackagesScreen.purchase` 3/3 (new), `wallets` 6/6 (new), `PackageSelectionSheet.payment` / `PackageCheckoutScreen.buyer` / `stripePublishableKey` updated and passing; 20 related suites (353 tests) pass. Failing before on 5b6eb654: renewing plan sells, trial setup mode, each error code's copy, poll timeout, double tap, wallets off.

## Contract gaps (backend follow-ups, mobile has fallbacks)
1. **Closed in backend #654 (48616468):** the filter now passes allowlisted extras (`amount_cents` etc. on `PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED`, `purchase_id` / `cancel_at_period_end` / `current_period_end` on `SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE`, the grant fields on `PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED`). The app reads them first and keeps the re-read fallbacks, so it works against either backend.
2. **Closed in backend #654 (48616468):** in-app checkout still sells only the client's own coach's packages, the same as payment-intent. A share link now sends its token, and the refusal becomes `PACKAGE_COACH_NOT_CONNECTED` with `reason` `no_coach|other_coach`. The app shows specific copy for each reason (join with that coach's invite code, or message the coach who shared the link). Without the token, the answer is unchanged.
3. Cancel is backend #628 (`POST /v1/checkout/subscriptions/:id/cancel`).

## Fix round 1 (B-RECUR-MOB, agent 114)
| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| #334 refused renewing plans | renewing -> subscription-intent -> PaymentSheet -> plan polling -> success | 632ab782 | PackageSelectionSheet.subscription "a renewing plan sells" |
| Trials | setup mode, seti_ secret, first-charge date in terms + success | 632ab782 | "a trial uses PaymentSheet setup mode" |
| Membership plans + share link used hosted Checkout webview | both on the shared native flow | 632ab782, e9499f8f | ClientPackagesScreen.purchase, PackageCheckoutScreen.buyer |
| Error codes need specific copy | every #654 / #628 code mapped | 632ab782, 3fc925d4 | "every backend code..." (it.each), Your plans PLAN_ALREADY_ENDED |
| Poll timeout | calm slow state + Check again | 632ab782 | "poll timeout shows the calm slow state" |
| Double tap / key reuse | in-flight guard; key per attempt | 632ab782 | "a double tap creates exactly one subscription attempt", key reuse tests |
| Apple / Google Pay off by config | wallets.ts + app.config.js plugin gate + env manifest | 632ab782, 59d3192f | wallets.test, "no merchant ID" |
| Secrets | memory only; Sentry payload asserted secret-free | 632ab782 | "short reference ... without secrets" |
| Cancel anytime must be true | Your plans panel (End / Keep my plan) | 632ab782, 3fc925d4 | ClientPackagesScreen.purchase |

## Fix round 2 (B-RECUR-BE, agent 114; this lane owns #334 since B-RECUR-MOB finished)
| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failed before at 3fc925d4, passes after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-334-1 `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED` showed the generic error, and every later tap resent the dead key | The hook drops the dead key and starts again once with a fresh key. If that also expires, it shows specific copy and the next tap gets a new key | 0629d506 | "SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED: starts once more with a fresh key", "... twice: specific copy, and the next tap uses a new key" |
| B-334-1 `PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED` showed the generic error | Specific copy per `included_by` (invite / free claim / purchase) plus Open your plan | 0629d506 | "PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED (invite / free_claim / purchase)" |
| #654 round 1 code `PACKAGE_COACH_NOT_CONNECTED` (share link) | Specific copy per `reason`. The share-link surface sends `share_token`, only to subscription-intent, only in the valid 21-character form | 0629d506 | "PACKAGE_COACH_NOT_CONNECTED (no_coach / other_coach)", "a share link sends its token" |
| #654 R1-3: `PACKAGE_IS_FREE` can come from subscription-intent | Falls back to claim-free, as the one-time path already did | 0629d506 | "PACKAGE_IS_FREE from subscription-intent" |

Every code backend #654 can answer now has its own copy and next action: CLIENT_NOT_FOUND, COACH_NOT_CONNECTED, COACH_NOT_PAYOUT_READY, CONNECT_NOT_CONFIGURED, ONE_TIME_REQUIRES_PAYMENT_INTENT, PACKAGE_ALREADY_INCLUDED, PACKAGE_COACH_NOT_CONNECTED, PACKAGE_INTERVAL_INVALID, PACKAGE_IS_FREE, PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND, PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED, PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS, PAYMENT_RETRY, PLAN_ALREADY_ENDED, PURCHASE_NOT_FOUND, STRIPE_CHECKOUT_ERROR, SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE, SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED, SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE.

Tests:
- Run with `ops/heavy.sh npx jest`:
  - `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription`: 35/35. Failing before: the 9 new cases fail, the other 26 skipped (`-t`). Log: `ops/brecurbe114/mob_failing_before.log`.
  - `PackageCheckoutScreen.buyer`, `ClientPackagesScreen.purchase`, `paymentsApi`: 40/40.
- Full `tsc --noEmit` is clean, and eslint is clean on the changed files.

Backward compatibility: the request only adds the optional `share_token`, which backend #654 accepts. That needs #654 deployed, which the merge order already requires.

Overlaps: #322 (ClientPackagesScreen), #321 (PackageDetailSurface: three optional props added).

**C-334-2 (composition gate, carried):** #322 is still open. Whichever of #322 / #334 merges second keeps #322's native Update card screen in `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx` and drops this branch's inherited hosted-portal `handleUpdateCard`; the merged tree gets a delta audit.

## Fix round 3 (B-RECUR-3, agent 115) @ 04104c2eb722e721101226e057a0701c84fe15ed
Start head 0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a (Sol REQUEST_CHANGES: B-334-3, B-334-4, C-334-2). Paired with backend#654 fix round 2 @ 02c48de710f9f69bfc985336eb14249663bbb638 (`mode: 'none'`, `checkout_state`, `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED.reason`).

Commits: 37271f9 (merge mobile main 4f1d74d), d8360e0 (tests only), b82a821 (fix), 04104c2 (merge mobile main 47124a4d, #326; clean, no overlap with the purchase files).

Failing-before: test-only commit d8360e0 (src = 0629d506 + main) on `ci/B-RECUR-3-334-before`, one-job CI lane run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142521981 — red: 2 suites, 18 failed / 35 passed (the decline control and all earlier cases pass). After: this PR's CI at 04104c2e.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (red in run 37142521981, green at 04104c2e) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-334-3 a sheet that threw / timed out / lost the connection / failed without card detail was reported as "nothing was charged" without reading the purchase | `runSheet` returns `uncertain` for those results (`isUncertainSheetResult`; a decline, auth failure or init failure stays definite). Subscription: the purchase and key are kept and `settleUncertain` reads `GET /subscriptions/:id`: entitled -> success; `payment_failed` -> failed-charge copy; `ended` -> checkout-ended copy; `paid`/`processing`/`card_saved` -> keep confirming (then the calm slow state); `awaiting_payment`/`awaiting_card` -> proven no-charge copy, and the next tap replays the same key; anything else (incl. `unknown`, a failed read) -> outcome-unknown copy (no charge claim), reference, Email support, **Check again**. One-time: reads the client's purchases for an entitled row of this package -> success, else outcome unknown + Check again, key kept | b82a821 | `PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx` "(failed before) the native call throws but the plan is paid -> success, never the no-charge copy"; "(failed before) a failure without card detail while Stripe shows no payment -> proven no charge; the retry replays the same key"; "(failed before) a timeout while Stripe cannot tell -> outcome unknown (no no-charge claim), reference, Check again finds the plan"; "(failed before) a dropped connection while the payment is processing keeps confirming, then succeeds"; "(failed before) the plan read itself fails -> outcome unknown"; "(failed before) a trial whose card sheet threw while Stripe shows no saved card ..."; "(failed before) one-time: the native call throws but the purchase is paid -> success"; "(failed before) one-time: unknown and no paid purchase yet -> outcome unknown with Check again, which finds the purchase"; control "a card decline is a definite answer (no plan read)" |
| B-334-3 checklist (c) unmount during the read | every await in the settle loops re-checks `mountedRef` and the attempt identity (`confirmingRef` / `oneTimeUnknownRef`) before any state write | b82a821 | "unmount during the plan read after an unknown outcome: no state write, no further reads" |
| B-334-4 the intent's terms were never reconciled with what the client saw before a chargeable sheet | `reconcileIntentTerms` (planTerms.ts) compares renewal price, one-time part, currency, interval, interval count and trial days (zero stays zero) with the package shown; any difference -> terms review (`price-changed` block with the review copy, the adopted terms and the planTerms CTA), no sheet; confirm replays the SAME key. A first charge that does not follow from the answered terms -> support notice, no sheet (never a review loop) | b82a821 | "(failed before) shown a 7-day trial, the backend answers no trial (already used) -> review, no sheet; confirm replays the same key and pays"; "(failed before) a combo whose one-time part moved -> review, no sheet"; "(failed before) a cadence change (monthly -> every 3 months) -> review, no sheet" |
| B-334-4 the one-time part was not sent | `createSubscriptionIntent(..., expectedOneTimeCents)` sends `expected_one_time_cents` (0 for a pure renewing plan) | b82a821 | "(failed before) the request carries the one-time part shown (combo and pure renewing)"; `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx` "posts subscription-intent ..." (body keys) |
| B-334-4 `resolvePriceChange` ignored one-time / currency / cadence and resurrected a removed trial (`fresh.trialDays \|\| pkg.trialDays`) | adopts `one_time_cents`, `currency`, `interval`, `interval_count` from the 409 body; the package re-read keeps `trialDays` as read (0 stays 0); review copy when more than the price moved | b82a821 | "(failed before) PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED read from the package never resurrects a removed trial"; "(failed before) PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED adopts the one-time part and cadence from the body" |
| #654 round 2 contract | `mode: 'none'` -> no sheet, confirm by polling, slow copy without "your card was accepted"; `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED` `reason: terms_changed` -> its own copy; `checkout_state` normalized on the plan | b82a821 | "mode none (paid without a sheet) -> no sheet, confirming, success"; "SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED terms_changed twice -> its own copy" |
| C-334-2 composition gate | carried: #322 is still OPEN. Whichever of #322 / #334 merges second keeps #322's native Update card screen in `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx`; the hosted-portal `handleUpdateCard` must not come back. The final merged tree needs a delta audit | — | — |

Updated: `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx` "PACKAGE_PRICE_CHANGED (price in the body) ..." — the confirmed attempt now answers the confirmed price (the reconciliation would otherwise correctly ask again).

Checklist: (a) Sentry gets cause / step / status / codes / short reference only (`reportPackagePaymentFailure`); the new test asserts no secret or key reaches it; (b) every await followed by a state write re-checks mount and attempt identity; (c) unmount race covered (row above); (d) new copy has no first person, no exclamation marks, no generic error, and never claims "nothing was charged" without Stripe's answer; (e) one failing-before test per finding. No package.json / lockfile change. Local: one spec at a time via heavy.sh (`recur3` 18/18, `subscription` 35/35, `payment` 22/22); eslint clean on the 7 changed files; no tsc locally (CI Typecheck runs it).

New backend fields consumed (all need #654 round 2 deployed, which the merge order already requires): `expected_one_time_cents` (request), `mode: 'none'`, `checkout_state`, `SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED.reason`. Against an older #654 the app still works: `checkout_state` absent -> outcome unknown + Check again (never a no-charge claim).

Status: CI running at 04104c2e; READY FOR AUDIT is added here only when every required check is green at that exact head.
title: feat(payments): renewing plans and one-time packages through one native PaymentSheet flow
